title: Creekside
description:
A cozy creekside getaway on the north side of Music City! A perfect place to relax after a busy day of sightseeing...or a long night on lower Broadway. Begin the day with a morning cup of coffee on the creekside deck and see a variety of birds and other wildlife. And end the day with a glass of wine while gazing at the stars in a pristine location away from all the city lights. Whether you're a morning bird or a night owl, you'll find peace and tranquility here at Creekside.

15 mins to downtown

The space
Creekside is a cozy room with a private outdoor entrance for your convenience. Your room includes plush bedding, a rattan breakfast dining set, coffee bar, microwave, mini-fridge and private bathroom. For entertainment, you'll find a smart tv as well as a variety of board games. Guests are responsible for logging in/out of streaming services.
Creekside includes one queen bed.
